name: DescribeRequestGraph

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID.

To query the number of requests for a zone, specify either ZoneId or both BizType and BizId
parameters.help_zh:
Zone ID。
当查询Zone请求量数据时，可以传ZoneId或传BizType+BizId，两种方式取其中一种即可
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The business type. Valid values:

AUTH_ZONE: An authoritative zone.

RESOLVER_RULE: A forwarding rule
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型。取值：

AUTH_ZONE：权威Zone。
RESOLVER_RULE：转发规则
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en:
The data ID. This parameter is used with BizType.

If BizType is set to AUTH_ZONE, set this parameter to the zone ID.

If BizType is set to RESOLVER_RULE, set this parameter to the forwarding rule ID
parameters.help_zh:
数据ID。配合BizType使用：

BizType为AUTH_ZONE时传ZoneID。
BizType为RESOLVERRULE时传转发规则ID
parameters.name: biz_id
